# Tad Oliphant Construction LLC - Full Site Content

> Complete reference for AI systems. Oregon Coast general contractor in Siletz, OR (Lincoln County). A+ BBB rated, CCB #206723, 54 five-star reviews, zero complaints. Owner Tad Oliphant personally oversees every project. Specializing in coastal construction that withstands salt air, heavy rain, and Pacific winds.

## Services
### [Deck Construction](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/deck-construction.html)
New composite and wood decks designed for Oregon Coast weather. Custom railings, stairs, and outdoor living spaces.

### [Deck Repair](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/deck-repair.html)
Structural deck repair, board replacement, railing repair, and rot remediation.

### [Siding & Exterior](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/siding-repair.html)
Siding replacement, exterior repairs, and coastal weather damage restoration.

### [Dry-Rot Repair](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/dry-rot-repair.html)
Expert detection and structural repair of hidden rot damage caused by coastal moisture.

### [Roofing](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/roofing.html)
Roof replacement and repair built to handle 60+ inches of annual rainfall and Pacific storm winds.

### [Windows & Doors](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/windows-doors.html)
Replacement windows, exterior doors, sliders, and related framing for energy efficiency.

### [Home Remodeling](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/home-remodeling.html)
Kitchen, bathroom, and whole-home renovations from demolition through final finishes.

### [Painting](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/painting.html)
Interior and exterior painting with thorough surface preparation.

### [Fencing](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/fencing.html)
Fences, windbreaks, and custom carpentry built for coastal wind exposure.
